run_bench_polysemous_1bn: run the FAISS 1B vector benchmark on SIFT or Deep1B datasets with a given index key
mmap_fvecs: memory-map a .fvecs file as a float32 numpy array using np.memmap for large datasets
mmap_bvecs: memory-map a .bvecs file as a float32 numpy array using np.memmap for large datasets
choose_train_size: compute the optimal training set size from a FAISS index key string for IVF or IMI indexes
get_trained_index: train a FAISS index on a subset of vectors and cache the trained index to disk
get_populated_index: add all base vectors to a trained FAISS index in batches and cache the populated index to disk
explore_operating_points: use faiss.ParameterSpace to autotune index parameters and find optimal recall-time tradeoffs
set_index_parameters: set FAISS index search parameters from a parameter string and run a recall benchmark
matrix_slice_iterator: iterate over rows of a numpy matrix in fixed-size blocks with thread-based pre-fetching
rate_limited_imap: create a single-thread pre-fetching iterator that processes the next element ahead of the current one
